notes.title: Drivable Tanks
notes.content:
- bug fixes a plenty
-i will explain whats next in a large update announcement soon

notes.title: Fix 5 (or 6)
notes.content:
we've just updated it to a new engine, hence the teething issues so I apologise for any annoying things popping up. 

You shall see them no more

anyway, heres the fixes
 - VR launch mode occurred to some people, I'm really sorry about that I don't use a VR headset so I can't actually test that. Its been fixed you should suffer from that no more.
-game should run slightly better, I've added some light optimisation work

notes.title: Fix 4
notes.content:
- bone crushing sounds and death by tank
- AA guns are now super lethal
 enjoy!

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Hello All! 

Thank you for you kind support, again it means the world to me. I've added a little overhaul of the plane customisation and how the logic for sorting the volleys work, hopefully there should be no further issues with it in the future. 

I've also taken the liberty to add a 3 shot missile barrage, a devastating payload should you be on the wrong end of it. There's also a new paratrooper deployment pod you can place on your plane. If the ground forces require assistance, count on these brave soldiers to dive head first into certain death.

happy hunting!
Yaz

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your support, it means the world to me! I've listened to your feedback and im working on the issues highlighted, involving frame drops and various other graphical issues. The waypoint, ui and various other physical glitches should be gone now. With an added time for waypoints to show imitating getting orientated :)

Again you are all amazing and keep the feedback coming in!

Yaz
